exposure: human Amniotic Membrane-derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells (hAM-MSCs)
Human Amniotic Membrane-derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells (hAM-MSCs)
outcome: Expression of activation markers (CD38, HLA-DR) on T lymphocytes
cohort: Human Amniotic Membranes (AM) obtained after caesarean section births from healthy women
finding: Human Amniotic Membrane-derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells (hAM-MSCs) demonstrated significant suppressive activity on T lymphocytes in vitro, inhibiting their proliferation, decreasing IFN-γ production, and downregulating activation markers.
